CODING AGENT & TS: No any, ReturnType<>, or inline imports. Use ES #private fields (no private/protected/public keywords except in constructor params). Use Promise.withResolvers(). Prompts must be static .md files with Handlebars. Use star re-exports in barrels. Import catalog values from @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog/<module>, not @oh-my-pi/pi-ai.

BUN/NODE: Prefer Bun APIs (Bun.file, Bun.write, Bun.sleep, Bun.spawn). Use namespace imports for node:fs, node:path, node:os.

MODEL POLICY: All model/provider logic must be in KDL files (packages/catalog/src/compat/rules/); never hard-code in TS. Run bun run gen:compat after edits. Never edit models.json or rules.json directly.

TUI/LOGGING: Use @oh-my-pi/pi-utils logger, not console.log. Sanitize TUI output using replaceTabs(), truncateToWidth(), shortenPath(), and PREVIEW_LIMITS.

TESTING/CI: Test observable contracts; no source-grepping, static echoes, or mock.module(). Use bun check (not tsc) and bun run test:rs (not cargo test).

GITHUB/PRs: Confirm before posting comments/issues. PRs require contributor's own words for changes. Follow specific Changelog attribution.

RUST: Use profiles dev, release, local, profiling, ci. Keep split-debuginfo on if debuginfo is present.

INFRASTRUCTURE: ~/.omp/agent symlinks to agents/fulton-omp-config. Use .ckrefs.toml for Codekeeper indexing.

GLOBAL OMP: Load Codekeeper and Hindsight Memory skills immediately. Resolve compressed tool output (hash=<hex>) via mcp__headroom_mcp_headroom_retrieve. Proactively compress outputs >300 lines via xd://mcp__headroom_mcp_headroom_compress.

WORKERS: Workers must re-enter cli.ts via declareWorkerHostEntry(). Validate with omp --smoke-test.

UTILITIES: Search packages/coding-agent/src/utils/, @oh-my-pi/pi-utils, and @oh-my-pi/pi-tui before writing helpers. Use @oh-my-pi/pi-natives/vcs for git/jj.

CHANGELOG: New entries go under [Unreleased]. Use specific attribution formats for internal/external changes. Release via bun run release.
